Hello, I always loved your work first off as an overseas fan, and I wanted to know if it was possible to receive a commission of my dnd OC, Opal! Is a dragon (specifically a dragon princess) and always wanted her design to be drawn by you (provided here) --> https://files.catbox.moe/vnj080.png

for a WRITTEN description of her design, here's what I have below:

Opal currently wears a red and grey regal-esque combat dress with a small boob window and a crystal adorning it. The dress ends to her knees, a grey witch hat with white dragon horns popping out. Her eyes are blue with slits in them as well as her pink hair being in a low ponytail with white hair streaks. She is of above average height and build and average bust size and She also often has scars on her arms/shoulders and face and has large brown Stone gauntlets, they are indeed stone.

She is currently sitting in a grassy field during sunset with a soft and meditative expression.

Again, thanks again if you take this!
